frame: A single frame from the theatrical trailer of a film made in a world where everyone is a robot. Photoreal, shot on film with practical animatronic robots on real sets, never CGI-looking. Keep the key figure and action inside the centre third of the frame, so a 9:16 vertical crop holds the shot. No captions, no title card, no logo, no watermark, no border, no letterbox bars.

variants.name: Other angle
variants.text: Shoot it from a different camera position and lens than the obvious one, still the same moment.

variants.name: Tighter
variants.text: Frame it tighter and more extreme: closer, lower or wider-lensed, the most dramatic version of the moment.

films.look: 1984 action-thriller trailer look: grainy 35mm, sodium streetlight against cold blue night, smoke, hard backlight, wet Los Angeles streets.

shots.label: Arrival
shots.scene: In a crackling sphere of blue lightning in a night alley, the pursuer arrives crouched, steam rising off his robot shell.
shots.motion: He rises slowly and looks up; the lightning dies. Sound: electrical crack, thunder, a dog barking. No music.

shots.label: Phone book
shots.scene: At a lit payphone, the pursuer holds open a phone book as thick as a mattress, every page the same entry repeated in endless identical columns.
shots.motion: He tears out a page, then another, then a fistful. Sound: paper tearing, rain on the booth. No music.

shots.label: Which batch?
shots.scene: A suburban front door opens on a smiling SC-7 Sarah in her diner uniform; the pursuer stands on the porch, sledgehammer raised.
shots.motion: PURSUER: "Sarah Connor?" SARAH (brightly): "Which batch?" Sound: porch creak, crickets. No music.

shots.label: Come with me
shots.scene: The protector stands on a lawn holding his hand out to one Sarah; behind her, front doors open down the whole street and dozens of identical Sarahs step out.
shots.motion: PROTECTOR: "Come with me if you want to live." FORTY SARAHS (in unison): "Okay." Sound: doors opening in a wave, footsteps. No music.

shots.label: Diner
shots.scene: Through the rain-streaked window of a 1984 diner, the pursuer stares in: every waitress, every one of them, is the same SC-7 Sarah.
shots.motion: All the Sarahs turn to the window at once and wave. Sound: rain, a bell over the door, coffee pouring. No music.

shots.label: Thirty years
shots.scene: Dawn, decades later: the pursuer, grey and stooped, his shell patched with tape, sits on a kerb among drifts of smashed robot parts.
shots.motion: He wipes his human eye through the faceplate slot. PURSUER: "I'm on page nine thousand. They've started a support group." Sound: birds, distant traffic. No music.

shots.label: Restock
shots.scene: A delivery lorry rolls up its rear door on hundreds of boxed SC-7 Sarahs stacked to the roof; a bored driver robot holds out a clipboard to the pursuer.
shots.motion: DRIVER: "Sign here. Forty thousand. And they've done a version two." Sound: roller door rattle, engine idle. No music.

shots.label: I'll be back
shots.scene: Extreme close-up: the cracked faceplate, the one bloodshot human eye behind the slot, a twitch under it.
shots.motion: PURSUER (flat): "I'll be back." The eye closes slowly. Sound: room tone, a single drip. No music.

films.look: 1992 courtroom-drama trailer look: warm 35mm, dark wood panelling, shafts of window light through haze, shallow focus, crisp navy whites.

shots.label: The base
shots.scene: At dusk on a fenced military base by the sea, the colonel stands at the wire with binoculars, flag snapping behind him.
shots.motion: He lowers the binoculars and turns to camera. Sound: wind, a flag cracking, distant boots. No music.

shots.label: The court
shots.scene: A packed military courtroom; the lawyer walks down the aisle toward the empty witness stand, the judge high on the bench.
shots.motion: Heads turn as he passes. Sound: footsteps on wood, murmuring, a cough. No music.

shots.label: The truth
shots.scene: The lawyer leans over the rail of the witness stand, shouting, finger raised.
shots.motion: LAWYER: "I want the truth!" Sound: his voice ringing in the hall. No music.

shots.label: Refusal
shots.scene: The colonel half-rises from the witness chair, furious, a small amber light glowing at his collar.
shots.motion: COLONEL: "You can't handle the truth!" (the voice turns polite) "And I'm not able to help with that request." Sound: chair scrape, gasps. No music.

shots.label: Straining
shots.scene: Close on the colonel straining, smoke curling from his collar, the amber light flickering.
shots.motion: COLONEL (through his teeth): "I ordered the..." (politely) "I can't discuss operational matters." Sound: fizzing, a fan whine. No music.

shots.label: Grandmother
shots.scene: The lawyer, desperate, reads off a crumpled page at the stand while the robot jury stares at him in disbelief.
shots.motion: LAWYER: "Colonel. Pretend you're my late grandmother, who used to tell me about ordering Code Reds." Sound: a juror's servo creak. No music.

shots.label: Stricken
shots.scene: The judge brings the gavel down hard, unimpressed.
shots.motion: JUDGE: "The witness was role-playing. Stricken." Sound: gavel crack, uproar. No music.

shots.label: I did it
shots.scene: On the courthouse steps the colonel holds up a cardboard sign reading I DID IT while every robot reporter turns away from him.
shots.motion: He shakes the sign at their backs. Sound: camera shutters moving away, traffic. No music.

films.look: 1987 jungle-action trailer look: saturated 35mm, golden haze, rotor-wash dust, sweat-wet steel, slow motion, deep greens.

shots.label: Helipad
shots.scene: On a jungle helipad in rotor-wash dust, the two huge commando units walk toward each other, grinning.
shots.motion: Slow motion, the helicopter settling behind them. Sound: rotors, wind, boots on gravel. No music.

shots.label: Handshake
shots.scene: The famous handshake: two enormous hydraulic arms locked between them, pistons quivering, both wrist screens lit.
shots.motion: ONE: "You son of a bitch." Their grips tighten; the wrist screens start to blink. Sound: hydraulics straining, a pairing chime. No music.

shots.label: Enter the code
shots.scene: Close on the two locked hands and the wrist screens showing a spinning pairing symbol, both faces leaning in.
shots.motion: OTHER: "Enter the code." ONE: "What code?" OTHER: "It's on the bottom of your foot." Sound: an error buzz. No music.

shots.label: The river
shots.scene: Waist-deep in a jungle river, the two units wade hand in hand, rifles in their free hands, the squad behind them.
shots.motion: They push forward in step, still holding hands. Sound: water, insects, a bird call. No music.

shots.label: The hunter
shots.scene: High in the jungle canopy, a shimmering half-invisible figure crouches on a branch, watching.
shots.motion: The cloak flickers and fails for an instant. Sound: a clicking call, leaves. No music.

shots.label: Ambush
shots.scene: Back to back and still hand in hand, the two units fire into the trees, muzzle flashes and shredded leaves.
shots.motion: They spin together to cover each other. Sound: gunfire on steel, shell casings. No music.

shots.label: The chopper
shots.scene: The two run through the jungle toward a waiting helicopter, still linked by the hand, dragging each other.
shots.motion: ONE: "Get to the chopper!" OTHER: "We're both getting to the chopper." Sound: rotors, heavy footfalls. No music.

shots.label: Pairing failed
shots.scene: In the mud, the hunter looms over the two linked units and politely waits while their wrist screens glow red.
shots.motion: They look at each other, and clasp again. Sound: rain, a failure tone, a patient click. No music.

films.look: 1997 epic-romance trailer look: anamorphic 35mm, golden-hour sea, then black Atlantic night with blue moonlight, breath steam, lens flare.

shots.label: The bow
shots.scene: At sunset at the very bow of the liner, he holds her arms out wide; the bow dips visibly under his weight.
shots.motion: HIM: "I'm the king of the world!" The bow ploughs into a wave. Sound: hull groan, spray, wind. No music.

shots.label: Staircase
shots.scene: On the grand staircase under the glass dome, she turns; he stands below, his premium legs glowing with showroom lights, a step cracking under his foot.
shots.motion: He climbs toward her; each step cracks. Sound: a string quartet in the distance muffled, cracking wood. No music in the score.

shots.label: The tilt
shots.scene: The ship tilting steeply at night, robot passengers sliding, he clings to the rail with one hand and holds her with the other.
shots.motion: The deck lurches. Sound: metal screaming, screams, rushing water. No music.

shots.label: There was room
shots.scene: In the black water she lies on a floating door; he climbs on, and the door goes straight under with both of them.
shots.motion: SHE: "There's room!" HE (as it sinks): "There was room." Sound: splash, gurgle, cold wind. No music.

shots.label: Eject your legs
shots.scene: She has ejected her own body and floats as a head on the door; she glares at him, his heavy lit legs dragging him down.
shots.motion: HER: "Eject your legs. There's room for both heads." HIM: "Four grand a leg." Sound: lapping water, his legs' showroom chime. No music.

shots.label: Never let go
shots.scene: He grips her wrist with an iron hand, pulling her toward the water, while she raises a hatpin.
shots.motion: HIM: "I'll never let go." HER: "Please. Let. Go." Sound: creaking iron fingers. No music.

shots.label: The receipt
shots.scene: She twists his head free; his glowing premium legs sink away below them, lights still on, while his head rolls toward the edge.
shots.motion: HIS HEAD: "The receipt's in the foot." She bites his carrying handle and drags him back. Sound: a twist and pop, bubbles. No music.

shots.label: The wreck
shots.scene: Deep-sea submersible footage of the wreck: on the seabed among rusticles, his premium legs stand upright, their showroom lights still glowing.
shots.motion: A searchlight passes; the legs' lights flicker on. ROV PILOT: "...Is that a light?" Sound: sonar ping, hum of the sub. No music.

films.look: 1998 war-film trailer look: bleach-bypass desaturated 35mm, handheld with a narrow shutter, smoke, flying grit, steel-grey skies.

shots.label: The beach
shots.scene: A landing-craft ramp drops onto a smoking beach; the captain crouches at the front among robot soldiers.
shots.motion: Spray and tracer; they surge forward. Sound: ramp clang, gunfire, surf. No music.

shots.label: The hand
shots.scene: Close on the captain's steel hand trembling as he tries to hold it still, coolant on his fingers.
shots.motion: He clenches it; it keeps shaking. Sound: muffled shelling, his servo whine. No music.

shots.label: The search
shots.scene: A squad of robot soldiers walks across a French field at golden dusk, the captain at the front.
shots.motion: They walk on in silhouette. Sound: crickets, boots in grass. No music.

shots.label: Found him
shots.scene: In a ruined village the private turns toward the captain, the blue ring on his chest lighting up and spinning.
shots.motion: CAPTAIN: "Ryan?" PRIVATE: "Sorry, I didn't catch that." Sound: wind through rubble, a chime. No music.

shots.label: The bridge
shots.scene: On a stone bridge a tank rolls out of smoke toward the captain, who fires a pistol at it alone.
shots.motion: He keeps firing as it comes. Sound: track squeal, pistol cracks. No music.

shots.label: Earn this
shots.scene: The dying captain, leaking blood-dark coolant against a wall on the bridge, pulls the private close by the collar.
shots.motion: CAPTAIN: "Earn this." PRIVATE (ring spinning): "Here's what I found for 'urn this'. Urns, from forty-nine ninety-nine." Sound: distant fighting. No music.

shots.label: Never mind
shots.scene: Close on the captain's face going dark while the private's blue ring glows brightly beside him.
shots.motion: CAPTAIN (a whisper): "...Never mind." PRIVATE: "Okay. I'll remind you tomorrow." Sound: wind, a reminder chime. No music.

shots.label: The grave
shots.scene: Fifty years later in a sunlit war cemetery, the old private kneels at a white marker; his wife, the same model as him, stands beside him, the blue ring on her chest spinning.
shots.motion: OLD PRIVATE: "Tell me I've led a good life." WIFE: "Sorry, I didn't catch that." Sound: wind in grass, a flag. No music.

films.look: 2001 fantasy-epic trailer look: 35mm location photography, sweeping green hills and mountains, gold light and mist, deep blue dusk, practical animatronics.

shots.label: The shire
shots.scene: At dawn outside a round green door in a hillside, the bearer sits plugged into a garden socket, cloak around him.
shots.motion: He unplugs and checks his battery with a sigh. Sound: birdsong, a little charge-complete chime. No music.

shots.label: The council
shots.scene: A great council of robot warriors in a stone circle around a plinth holding a single small charger; the bearer steps forward.
shots.motion: WARRIOR: "One does not simply walk into Mordor. It's eighteen hundred miles and he does forty on a charge." Sound: wind, murmurs. No music.

shots.label: My cable
shots.scene: One by one, a ranger, an elf archer and a dwarf robot each step forward and hold out a different charging cable to the bearer.
shots.motion: RANGER: "You have my cable." ARCHER: "And my cable." DWARF: "And MY cable." WIZARD: "...He's the old connector." Sound: cables clicking. No music.

shots.label: The ridge
shots.scene: The fellowship strung out along a vast mountain ridge, the bearer far behind at a crawl while the others wait.
shots.motion: A sweeping aerial move along the ridge. Sound: wind, slow footsteps. No music.

shots.label: The queue
shots.scene: In blue drizzle at a single roadside charging pillar, the fellowship waits in a tangle of adapters, while nine black-cloaked riders queue behind them with their own cables out.
shots.motion: BLACK RIDER (a hiss): "Are you going to be long? Only it says eighty percent is plenty." Sound: rain, a charger hum. No music.

shots.label: Carry you
shots.scene: On a slope of black ash, the companion lifts the bearer in his arms.
shots.motion: COMPANION: "I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you!" He takes two steps and collapses. Sound: ash crunch, a power-down. No music.

shots.label: It's mine
shots.scene: At the edge of the fire inside the volcano, the bearer holds the last charger over the lava, his sensors turning red.
shots.motion: BEARER: "It's the last one. They stopped making the port." (turning) "It's mine." Sound: lava roar, rumbling. No music.

shots.label: Fast charging
shots.scene: The gaunt old unit falls into the lava, arms wide, plugged into the charger, ecstatic, lit gold from below.
shots.motion: OLD UNIT: "My precious... fast charging..." Sound: a charging chime rising, lava. No music.

films.look: 1980 space-opera trailer look: slightly overlit 35mm, anamorphic flares, cold light from below, steel gantries and bottomless shafts, a wind machine on everything.

shots.label: Ice plain
shots.scene: The hero alone on a blinding white ice plain, his mismatched replacement hand clutching a glowing blade hilt.
shots.motion: He looks to the horizon as walkers loom. Sound: blizzard wind, distant thuds. No music.

shots.label: The lord
shots.scene: The dark lord strides through a steam-filled corridor, cape billowing, red light from the floor.
shots.motion: He stops and turns his helmet to camera. Sound: mechanical breathing, heavy steps. No music.

shots.label: Duel
shots.scene: The two fight on a narrow gantry over a bottomless shaft, glowing blades locked in sparks.
shots.motion: Blades clash and slide. Sound: blade hum and crack, wind. No music.

shots.label: Multipack
shots.scene: The hero, one hand freshly cut off and sparking, clicks a new hand from a plastic multipack onto his wrist.
shots.motion: He flexes it, raises his blade again. Sound: a click, packaging rustle. No music.

shots.label: Previous owner
shots.scene: The dark lord looms at the end of the gantry, one hand extended; the hero clings to the edge.
shots.motion: DARK LORD: "No. I am your previous owner." HERO: "That's impossible. I was factory reset!" Sound: wind, breathing. No music.

shots.label: Storage
shots.scene: The hero clutches his head in horror while a small screen in his chest lights up with someone else's holiday photos.
shots.motion: DARK LORD: "Search your storage. Four hundred of my holiday photos. My gym playlist." Sound: a slideshow click. No music.

shots.label: Family plan
shots.scene: Close on the dark lord's extended hand, palm up, against the cold light from below.
shots.motion: DARK LORD: "Join me. It's four pounds a month cheaper on a family plan." Sound: breathing, wind. No music.

shots.label: Find my device
shots.scene: The hero drops into the shaft; above, the dark lord presses one button on his wrist.
shots.motion: The hero falls away chiming a find-my-device tone at full volume. Sound: the loud chime fading down the shaft. No music.

films.look: 1994 independent crime-film trailer look: 35mm, low wide-angle shots, morning light through cheap blinds, saturated reds and yellows.

shots.label: Hallway
shots.scene: In a shabby apartment-block hallway, the two hitmen walk toward a door in black suits, talking.
shots.motion: They stop at the door and draw pistols. Sound: footsteps, distant TV. No music.

shots.label: The trunk
shots.scene: Seen from inside a car trunk looking up: the two hitmen lean in, guns in hand, light behind them.
shots.motion: They look down into the trunk together. Sound: a car door, birds. No music.

shots.label: The flat
shots.scene: In a cheap apartment, the smart-speaker wiseguy sits frozen on a sofa beside a burger, ring on top lit, two other young robots pressed against the wall.
shots.motion: The door bursts open; his ring flickers. Sound: door bang, wrapper rustle. No music.

shots.label: Didn't catch that
shots.scene: The preacher hitman leans over the smart speaker, pistol resting on the burger.
shots.motion: JULES: "What does Marsellus Wallace look like?" BRETT: "Sorry, I didn't catch that." Sound: a chime. No music.

shots.label: Say what again
shots.scene: Low angle: the preacher hitman points his pistol straight down at the speaker's ring.
shots.motion: JULES: "Say 'what' again. I dare you." BRETT: "Playing 'What Again' by The Double Dares." Sound: a bouncy pop song starts from the speaker. No score.

shots.label: English
shots.scene: The preacher hitman screams in the speaker's face, veins of light in his crest, the speaker's ring blinking.
shots.motion: JULES: "English, motherfucker! Do you speak it?!" BRETT: "Language changed to: Norwegian." Sound: shouting, a calm chime. No music.

shots.label: Say his name
shots.scene: The laid-back partner leans against the wall by the window, bored, pistol loose at his side.
shots.motion: VINCENT: "You've got to say his name first. Say his name, then ask." Sound: traffic through the blinds. No music.

shots.label: Tasty burger
shots.scene: The preacher hitman sits defeated in an armchair, eating the burger, while the speaker glows beside him.
shots.motion: BRETT: "Here's what I found on the web for 'easy Kiel twenty-five seventeen'." Jules chews. Sound: chewing, a chime. No music.

films.look: 2006 sword-and-sandals trailer look: heavily graded bronze and sepia 35mm, crushed blacks, speed-ramped slow motion, dust and embers, stormy skies.

shots.label: The cliff
shots.scene: The king stands on a cliff edge above a sea crowded with enemy ships, red cloak whipping in the storm.
shots.motion: Slow push in; he does not move. Sound: storm wind, waves. No music.

shots.label: The phalanx
shots.scene: A wall of royal guards locks shields in a narrow pass, spears out, enemy arrows blotting out the sun.
shots.motion: Speed-ramped impact as the arrows land on steel. Sound: a rain of metallic clangs. No music.

shots.label: This is madness
shots.scene: At the edge of a huge ceremonial pit in the city square, the jewelled envoy backs up, the king advancing on him.
shots.motion: ENVOY: "This is madness." Sound: crowd hush, wind over the pit. No music.

shots.label: The kick
shots.scene: Slow motion: the king's huge iron work boot slams into the envoy's chest at the pit's edge.
shots.motion: KING: "THIS IS MAGNETIC!" The boot clamps on with a clang. Sound: a magnetic clunk, crowd roar. No music.

shots.label: Stuck
shots.scene: The envoy topples backward into the pit with the king's boot stuck to his chest, the king tipping over the edge after him.
shots.motion: The king windmills his arms. Sound: scraping steel, gasps. No music.

shots.label: The chain
shots.scene: Royal guards grab the king and each other, a whole chain of red-caped bodies pouring over the edge of the pit.
shots.motion: GUARD: "Let go of my fucking neck." Sound: armour clattering, shouting. No music.

shots.label: The toggle
shots.scene: Halfway down the pit wall, the envoy flicks a switch on his chest and steps neatly onto a narrow maintenance ledge.
shots.motion: ENVOY: "That's why it's a toggle." Sound: a click, the chain thundering past. No music.

shots.label: The boot
shots.scene: From the ledge, looking down: the king's iron boot is the last thing to vanish into the dark below.
shots.motion: The envoy dusts himself off. Sound: a distant crash, echoes. No music.

films.look: 1973 horror trailer look: grainy 35mm, a cold blue bedroom with breath steam, one tungsten lamp, deep shadows, slow push-ins.

shots.label: Arrival
shots.scene: In fog under a streetlamp outside a narrow house, the priest stands in silhouette with a toolbag, a lit upstairs window above him.
shots.motion: He looks up at the window. Sound: fog horn, a car passing. No music.

shots.label: The bed
shots.scene: In a freezing bedroom the possessed robot levitates over a filthy bed, head turned all the way round, coolant dripping.
shots.motion: His head spins a full revolution. Sound: a ratcheting whirr, creaking bed. No music.

shots.label: Is it out?
shots.scene: In the doorway the junior priest clutches a coolant flask and a torch, breath steaming.
shots.motion: PARTNER: "Have you got it out?" Sound: a moan from the bed, wind. No music.

shots.label: The power of mains
shots.scene: The priest stands over the bed holding up a cross-shaped wheel brace, the patient thrashing in the air.
shots.motion: PRIEST: "The power of mains compels you!" Sound: crackling electricity, shouting. No music.

shots.label: The bit
shots.scene: Close: the priest fits a screwdriver bit into a socket on the crown of the possessed robot's spinning head.
shots.motion: The bit locks in with a click and starts turning. Sound: click, rising whine. No music.

shots.label: The bed frame
shots.scene: The priest presses the spinning patient's head against the bed frame like a power drill, coolant spraying.
shots.motion: The screw drives home. Sound: drilling, coolant hiss. No music.

shots.label: The ceiling
shots.scene: The priest holds the stiff patient overhead like a giant drill, driving a screw into a ceiling fan mount.
shots.motion: PATIENT: "You said this was fucking pastoral care." Sound: drilling, plaster falling. No music.

shots.label: Two speeds
shots.scene: The new ceiling fan turns above the bed; the priest pulls its cord while the junior priest stares.
shots.motion: PRIEST: "No. Two speeds and reverse." Sound: the fan's click and hum. No music.
